scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: A fictional game message promises Kabir a rare outfit for free. The large picture shows a reward, but the small instructions ask for an account password. Meera reads the requested action aloud before thinking about how exciting the prize looks.
scenes.speech: A fictional game message promises Kabir a rare outfit for free. The large picture shows a reward, but the small instructions ask for an account password. Meera reads the requested action aloud before thinking about how exciting the prize looks.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A reward claim and a requested action are different parts of an offer. Free in a heading does not mean there is no cost or risk. Giving a password can hand over account control even when no money changes hands in the story.
scenes.speech: A reward claim and a requested action are different parts of an offer. Free in a heading does not mean there is no cost or risk. Giving a password can hand over account control even when no money changes hands in the story.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The club uses pretend messages to practise pausing. Students do not click links, pay fees or share real secrets to see whether a claim is genuine. They ask a trusted adult and use a known game or school route when a real offer needs checking.
scenes.speech: The club uses pretend messages to practise pausing. Students do not click links, pay fees or share real secrets to see whether a claim is genuine. They ask a trusted adult and use a known game or school route when a real offer needs checking.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The offer asks for an account password to claim a free outfit. It is not inside a known approved reward process. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: The offer asks for an account password to claim a free outfit. It is not inside a known approved reward process. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: What should Kabir do with the reward message?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Keep the password private, stop interacting and ask a trusted adult. A free reward is not a reason to give someone control of an account.
scenes.speech: Keep the password private, stop interacting and ask a trusted adult. A free reward is not a reason to give someone control of an account.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through reward claims, then hidden demands, then a pause before action. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
